'''Mike Kalinovich No Power Characters''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mike Kalinovich]]
* '''Published:''' September 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi War Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassiwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' No Power Characters
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH No Power Characters Kalinovich LS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Ok, I've read all of these decks that all include major characters, mainly Obi-Wan. Here's a deck that throws a twist to the Dark player using anti-Obi decks (ex. Circle Complete).

== Strategy ==

'''Strategy:''' First, use Y4MWR as starting location. Try to get Y4 system out asap. Thus, rebel planners increases the benefit. As with 8 ships, power = power + 8, the equivalent of an extra ISD for Light. Dark usually plays Kessel, for the force icons, but, with 8 ships versus 7-10, 2-3 of ISDs, Full Throttle/Special Mods make a huge benefit. Since almost ALL Darks play the DS Sites, DSPlans is quite effective with this deck. The Bantha droid protects ALL ships from attrition 3. Good since most decks contain average destiny of about 2.3.

Key card combo is Radar Scanner/Leesub Sirln. Play the interrupt on your turn, so the opponent can't do anything to his deck. Scan, use Leesubs talent of pick a card right, its lost...hey. Its a cheap, but effective way of eliminating some cards.

I don't use Obi, since I don't have him, but Luke/Leia are just as effective, since use a saber on Luke, put Han's pistol on Leia, or Leia's pistol on Leia, doesn't matter, since both are in.

Seeker strategy is to play at your Y4 Docking Bay, thus, as soon as any Alien comes to the DB, automatically gone, so good for Wuher. Helps break up the Vader/Tarkin combo, which I use in my Dark deck.

The scomplink cancels Boring Conversation Anyway, which is a deadly Dark interrupt, which cancels just about most Light interupts, and has a destiny of 5. Much better than alter/sense which have 4/3 respectively. But 2x is a handy droid to use for additional power in a battle.
